test_Tanh_forward: test the Tanh bijector forward method to apply element-wise tanh transformation on JAX arrays
test_Tanh_inverse: test the Tanh bijector inverse method to recover original values from tanh-transformed arrays
test_Tanh_forward_log_det_jacobian: test the Tanh bijector forward_log_det_jacobian method to compute log determinant of the Jacobian
test_Tanh_inverse_log_det_jacobian: test the Tanh bijector inverse_log_det_jacobian method to compute inverse log determinant of the Jacobian
test_Tanh_same_as: test the Tanh bijector same_as method to compare two bijector instances for equality
